description: Download links and sort folders on macOS with Rays. Runs locally; install Rays first (brew install --cask a6n-ai/tap/rays).

tools.name: add_downloads
tools.description: Download one or more http/https links with Rays.

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.description: List downloads with state, progress and file name.

tools.name: sorter_status
tools.description: Watched folders, categories, settings and recent moves.

tools.name: sort_folder
tools.description: Sort a folder into category folders; dry run unless dry_run is false.
